name: fast-video-cataloger
description: Search, view and tag your local video library from Claude: transcripts, scenes, visual search.
long_description:
Fast Video Cataloger keeps a searchable catalog of your own video files on Windows: scene thumbnails, keywords, transcripts and faces. This extension lets Claude work with that catalog. Find videos and moments by what was said or by what the picture shows (visual search, nothing tagged first), fetch scene thumbnails to judge a shot, and, with an Editor key, tag videos, gather clips into bins and edit the catalog: video details, cast, people, keywords and keyword groups.

**Requires Fast Video Cataloger 10.4 or later** (Windows, free 30-day trial) with your catalog shared through its server: in the program, open the start page's Server section and click Setup. Create an API key with Manage Users in the same section: Viewer to search and read, Editor to also tag, build bins and edit the catalog.

The extension talks to the Fast Video Cataloger server on your own computer. No video is uploaded; Claude receives the titles, transcript lines and scene images it asks for.

tools.name: search_videos
tools.description: Find videos by free text or by keyword.

tools.name: search_scenes
tools.description: Find individual scenes, with their timecodes.

tools.name: search_scenes_semantic
tools.description: Find scenes by describing what is in the picture, or scenes that look like a given one. Nothing has to be tagged.

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Find spoken words, with their video and timecode.

tools.name: search_actors
tools.description: Find people by name or tag.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: One catalog entry in full.

tools.name: get_video_scenes
tools.description: A video's scene thumbnails in timecode order.

tools.name: get_video_transcript
tools.description: A video's transcript as timed lines.

tools.name: list_keywords
tools.description: The keywords the catalog actually uses, to search with.

tools.name: get_video_tags
tools.description: A video's keywords.

tools.name: get_video_actors
tools.description: A video's cast.

tools.name: get_scene_image
tools.description: The thumbnail image itself, so the assistant can see the shot.

tools.name: catalog_stats
tools.description: Catalog size and the Fast Video Cataloger build serving it.

tools.name: list_bins
tools.description: The catalog's bins (collections).

tools.name: get_bin_videos
tools.description: The videos in a bin.

tools.name: tag_video
tools.description: Add keywords to a video (Editor key).

tools.name: untag_video
tools.description: Remove named keywords from a video (Editor key).

tools.name: untag_scene
tools.description: Remove named keywords from a scene (Editor key).

tools.name: tag_scene
tools.description: Add keywords to a single scene (Editor key).

tools.name: create_bin
tools.description: Create a bin (Editor key).

tools.name: add_video_to_bin
tools.description: Add a video to a bin (Editor key).

tools.name: remove_video_from_bin
tools.description: Take a video out of a bin - the counterpart to add_video_to_bin.

tools.name: update_video
tools.description: Change a video's title, description, link or rating.

tools.name: add_actor_to_video
tools.description: Record that a person appears in a video.

tools.name: remove_actor_from_video
tools.description: Remove a person from one video's cast - the counterpart to add_actor_to_video.

tools.name: keyword_usage
tools.description: How many videos and how many scenes carry one keyword.

tools.name: rename_keyword
tools.description: Rename a keyword everywhere it is used, on videos and on scenes alike.

tools.name: delete_keyword
tools.description: Delete one keyword from the catalog: it is taken off every video, every scene or both, and cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_keyword_groups
tools.description: List the keyword groups the user sorted their video keywords into, such as 'Places' or 'Clients', each with the keywords in it.

tools.name: create_keyword_group
tools.description: Create a keyword group to sort video keywords into.

tools.name: add_keyword_to_group
tools.description: Put a video keyword into a keyword group.

tools.name: remove_keyword_from_group
tools.description: Take a keyword out of a keyword group - the counterpart to add_keyword_to_group.

tools.name: rename_keyword_group
tools.description: Rename a keyword group.

tools.name: delete_keyword_group
tools.description: Delete a keyword group.

tools.name: create_actor
tools.description: Add a person to the catalog, so they can be put in a video's cast with add_actor_to_video.

tools.name: update_actor
tools.description: Change a person's name, bio or link.

tools.name: delete_actor
tools.description: Delete a person from the catalog.

tools.name: set_video_path
tools.description: Change where a catalog entry looks for its video file, for a file that was moved or renamed outside Fast Video Cataloger.

tools.name: index_video
tools.description: Index a catalog entry that has no thumbnails yet (Editor key).

tools.name: list_videos_needing_indexing
tools.description: Catalog entries that have no thumbnails yet.

server_url.title: Fast Video Cataloger server address
server_url.description: The address of your Fast Video Cataloger server. Leave as is when it runs on this computer.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Create one in Fast Video Cataloger with Manage Users in the start page's Server section. Viewer to search and read, Editor to also tag and build bins.
